findings.result: Saved questions are cloned and only prompt.vi/explanation.vi differences are accepted for continuing the original draft. ID/order/Chinese/options/tokens/answer/audio/source/extra fields remain part of closed authority. Review includes 7 additional field-substitution probes per course.

Old answers are preserved and require explicit acknowledgement when the registered VI display is active. The listening renderer retained all answers and its missing UI through a synthetic quota failure, then a repeated acknowledgement successfully saved and restored editable controls.

Existing unsnapshotted drafts remain editable while the registry is null. A first actual answer captures current shown question values; invalid older unsubmitted answers remain repairable rather than forcing historical scoring.

commitCourseAttempt compares the saved draft question array or individual round snapshot with attempt.questions before durable commit. Synthetic substitutions produced zero writes and left original storage bytes unchanged.

Object.assign keeps the current local round identity during first capture. An actual renderer-driven choice after acknowledgement successfully committed its original snapshot exactly once in the independent harness.

Static wiring passes the validated active-registry flag to both draft resolvers. main.ts restores the selector to route.lesson when flush rejects, catches acknowledgement errors, retains disabled states on missing/incompatible views, and uses saved draft questions for grading. Real browser event behavior is pending.
